runtime_injections.scope: building-gate server lifecycle only (hard-kill adoption test)
runtime_injections.justification: After production's REAL atomic journal write whose payload carries phase='building' has returned durable, record the journal path in a signal file and block the native worker thread forever so the test can hard-kill the exact child process at a durably persisted building journal. Nothing is skipped or mocked; the write itself is the unmodified production write.

runtime_injections.scope: controlled-clock-fence-loss server lifecycle only; exact run_id+epoch target file; one-shot
runtime_injections.justification: Deterministic REAL writer-fence loss for the A5 INV-F4 installed proof: the acquire wrapper only records the productive lease instance unchanged; after production's real atomic journal write with phase='building' for the exact targeted run/epoch has returned durable, that exact lease is released exactly once through its OFFICIAL release path (no artificial exception, no SQL, no fabricated terminal). The very next productive fence check raises GlobalDiscoveryWriterFenceLost and the productive worker alone persists PARTIAL/recovery_physical_reconciliation_pending; the test awaits that terminal inside the same server so shutdown stays clean and bounded, and captures the frozen durable-building N journal bytes as evidence.

runtime_injections.scope: resume-gate restart lifecycle only; exact run_id+epoch target file, one-shot
runtime_injections.justification: Cooperative hold of the REAL native operation for the exact resumed run/epoch N+1 written by the test BEFORE the restart server exists, so the canonical public resume replay (same actor, same reason, strictly before terminal) can be proven to preserve the exact persisted N+1 identity and exactly one recovery dispatch with zero epoch N+2, while its documented live projection (state/phase/reason_code/progress_seq/heartbeat_at/updated_at/active_elapsed_ms) legitimately advances under the native gate — total payload identity is NOT claimed. Claim/heartbeat stay fully productive during the hold; the release file is written unconditionally in the test's finally, and a 120s deadline proceeds WITHOUT fabricating any error while leaving a timeout marker the test must prove absent.

runtime_injections.scope: z2-tamper server lifecycle only; exact run_id+epoch+variant target file written by the test after prepare+confirm and before the MCP run; one-shot
runtime_injections.justification: Production creates the durable worker-inputs artifact INSIDE prepare_durable_start, so no confirm-to-start tamper window exists. The wrapper calls the REAL put first; for the exact targeted run/epoch it then locates the hash-keyed artifact (worker_inputs_<SHA256(run_id)>__attempt-N), records a signal with run/epoch/variant/path/original SHA256, and unlinks it (missing) or truncates it to invalid JSON (corrupt) strictly before the put returns — therefore strictly before the recovery dispatch exists. A test-only tripwire on GlobalDiscoveryWriterLease.acquire writes a marker and fails if the targeted run's owner ever reaches the writer lane; the test must prove the marker ABSENT. The correct zero-work claim is: zero writer lease, zero reconcile/cutover, zero physical mutation of the observed global tree — the input READ itself legitimately happens inside the native wrapper, which fails typed.

runtime_injections.scope: adoption-restart server lifecycle only (hard-kill restart); single signal
runtime_injections.justification: Writes ONE UTC timestamp at the restarted recovery poller's first entry and then delegates to the REAL _poll unchanged. The bounded-takeover proof anchors on persisted ground truth: adopted claimed_at must be >= the old claim expiry and <= max(old claim expiry, this first-poll signal) + poll interval + fixed margin — never on a wall-clock observation that includes installed boot/readiness time.

runtime_injections.scope: adoption-restart server lifecycle only (hard-kill restart); exact run_id+epoch target file, one-shot
runtime_injections.justification: Cooperative hold positioned AFTER the adopting claim transaction (which carries the A5R2 exactly-once crash charge) has durably COMMITTED and BEFORE _run_attempt starts any physical operation. At the gate the test proves the EXACT settled accounting from the SQL ground truth: active == pre_active + gap and cumulative == pre_cumulative + gap with gap = min(old claim expiry, active deadline) - pre heartbeat, plus heartbeat_at/updated_at rebased to the adopting claim's own claimed_at — before releasing any new work. The release file is written unconditionally in the test's finally; a 120s deadline proceeds WITHOUT fabricating any error while leaving a timeout marker the test must prove absent. The wrapper delegates to the REAL _submit_claim unchanged.
